message:
Wedding Catering: What Does the Per-Plate Price Include?

A per-head quote can mean very different things. Confirm whether it covers staff, rentals (plates, glassware, linens), setup and cleanup, and service charges, or whether those are extra.

Add up food, staff, rentals, bar, service charge and tax before you compare. The lowest per-plate number often isn't the lowest total.
